notes.title: Welcome to Whispergrave Isle!
notes.content:
A new island has emerged from the mist — Whispergrave Isle is now live!

This haunting new area is shrouded in fog and filled with an eerie atmosphere. It features its own spooky music theme and a unique set of creepy artifacts, each with a mysterious backstory to uncover… if you dare to dig.

Also in this update:
[list]
[*]All islands now have their own unique name.
[*]The museum grounds now include a proper shoreline slope.
[*]Fixed colliders in mountain side.
[*]Fixed floating bones in the desert island.
[*]The Credits menu has been updated to thank our newest beta testers!
[/list]

Dare to explore? Whispergrave awaits.

notes.title: Quality of life and better mining!
notes.content:
[b]General improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new and improved UI icons.
[*]Added new and improved cleaning brush model.
[*]Picking up cleaned artifact from cleaning station no longer consumes 1 stamina.
[/list]

[b]Mining / Smithing improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced mining time from 5s to 2s.
[*]Increased chance of spawning void steel ores.
[*]Added more mining rocks.
[*]Added option to sell leftover ore and ingot in the smithing menu.
[*]Added 3 smithing related achievements.
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed game executable title and name.
[*]Fixed museum not saving if closing menu with esc.
[*]Fixed typo in museum objective text.
[/list]

notes.title: Mining, smithing, travelling and more!
notes.content:
Added a new mining and smithing activity to the winter island.
Added more nature items to make islands feel more alive.
Added a lot more sound effects.
Added inspect option to artifact stands.

Reworked the money system, ticket income is now collected from the manager.
Reworked travel system, now done from new docks by talking to the sailor.

Improved several UIs.

Several quality of life changes.
Several changes to the environments to improve overall feeling and mood.
